query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create, update, query, and verify Notion database rows and page content for generic deal-room style pages, including owner lookup, bulk content replacement, child-page preservation, and database filtering.
query_ground_truth.intent: Read existing page content and perform bulk replacements while preserving child pages.

requirement_groups.purpose: Replace page content safely with child-page preservation

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate the full block tree using NOTION_FETCH_ALL_BLOCK_CONTENTS (walk children to collect block_ids and every rich_text span eligible for find/replace).
[Optional (for readable baseline/rollback text)] [Prerequisite]: Export the page using NOTION_GET_PAGE_MARKDOWN (capture before-state and later diff/verification).
[Optional (before destructive or wide changes)] [Prerequisite]: Create a safety snapshot using NOTION_DUPLICATE_PAGE (quick rollback copy).
[Required] [Step]: Compute replacements per block (apply find/replace to each rich_text while preserving annotations/structure; ensure required rich_text is never empty).
[Required] [Step]: Write changes per affected block using NOTION_UPDATE_BLOCK (send the complete desired content for that block; iterate until all matches are updated).
[Optional (for verification)] [Next Step]: Re-read using NOTION_FETCH_ALL_BLOCK_CONTENTS or NOTION_GET_PAGE_MARKDOWN (confirm all occurrences changed and formatting preserved).

[Fallback (if many blocks must be rewritten or updates are too fragmented)] [Fallback]: Overwrite children using NOTION_REPLACE_PAGE_CONTENT (prefer archiving existing children); if remnants remain, archive with NOTION_DELETE_BLOCK and re-add in batches via NOTION_ADD_MULTIPLE_PAGE_CONTENT, then verify by re-reading.
[Optional (if you only have a browser URL)] [Prerequisite]: Convert URL to doc/page identifiers using CODA_RESOLVE_BROWSER_LINK (avoid manual parsing).
[Required Prerequisite (if pageIdOrName unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find the target page using CODA_LIST_PAGES (select correct pageIdOrName; follow continuation link/pageToken until found).
[Optional (if you must confirm current canvas/anchor before editing)] [Prerequisite]: Read existing content/structure using CODA_LIST_PAGE_CONTENT (decide append vs replace, confirm insert location).
[Required] [Step]: Append/insert/replace page canvas using CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE (set contentUpdate.insertionMode; set canvasContent.format/content, e.g., markdown).
[Optional (if downstream depends on confirmed write)] [Next Step]: Verify async completion using CODA_GET_MUTATION_STATUS (poll requestId returned by CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE).
[Optional (if CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE returns 404 page not found)] [Fallback]: Re-derive a valid pageIdOrName using CODA_LIST_PAGES or CODA_RESOLVE_BROWSER_LINK, then retry CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE.
known_pitfalls: [NOTION_UPDATE_BLOCK] Updates replace the block’s content rather than patching substrings; you must send the full intended rich_text for that block.
[NOTION_REPLACE_PAGE_CONTENT] Requests fail if any child block in new_children omits the required type discriminator (schema cannot be inferred).
[NOTION_REPLACE_PAGE_CONTENT] Blocks that require rich_text can error if rich_text is empty; supply a minimal placeholder text object when needed.
[NOTION_REPLACE_PAGE_CONTENT] The API may apply partial deletes/appends; confirm using response summaries and always verify by re-reading.
[NOTION_DELETE_BLOCK] Archiving requires correct child block_ids; nested descendants require full traversal via NOTION_FETCH_ALL_BLOCK_CONTENTS.
[CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE] May return only page id + requestId (async mutation), not updated content; use CODA_GET_MUTATION_STATUS if you must confirm completion.
[CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE] insertionMode and canvasContent.format control placement/rendering; insertionMode="replace" can wipe a page—get explicit confirmation.
[CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE] Can fail with 404 "Could not find a page with the specified ID or name" when pageIdOrName is wrong; retry after obtaining a valid (often "canvas-…") ID via CODA_LIST_PAGES.
[CODA_LIST_PAGES] Small limits (observed 50) may miss the target; responses can include a continuation link (data.href with pageToken) requiring additional fetches.
[CODA_LIST_PAGE_CONTENT] Field naming can differ (doc_id/page_id_or_name vs docId/pageIdOrName); mismatches can cause request-shape errors.

NOTION_FETCH_ALL_BLOCK_CONTENTS.description: Tool to fetch all child blocks for a given Notion block. Use when you need a complete listing of a block's children beyond a single page; supports optional recursive expansion of nested blocks.

block_id.description: Identifier (UUID) of the parent Notion block or page whose children to list. Pages are blocks in Notion. Accepts UUIDs with or without hyphens (e.g., 'c02fc1d3-db8b-45c5-a222-27595b15aea7' or 'c02fc1d3db8b45c5a22227595b15aea7'). Either block_id or page_url must be provided. The block must be shared with your integration.

page_url.description: Notion page URL from which to extract the page/block ID. Either block_id or page_url must be provided. NOTE: Database view URLs (those containing '?v=' parameter) are NOT supported. Database views are filtered views of a database and do not have block children. To access database content, use the NOTION_QUERY_DATABASE action instead.

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth when recursive=true. Prevents excessive nesting traversal. Defaults to 10. Set higher for deeply nested structures, lower for faster results.

page_size.description: Maximum number of child blocks to return per request. Defaults to 100, with a maximum of 100 as per Notion API limits.

recursive.description: If true, fetches nested children for blocks with 'has_children' set to true, appending all descendants to the output list. Subject to max_depth and max_blocks limits.

max_blocks.description: Maximum total blocks to return when recursive=true. Prevents runaway fetches on extremely large block trees. Defaults to 5000. When limit is reached, blocks fetched so far are returned with a warning in the response.

NOTION_UPDATE_BLOCK.description: Updates existing Notion block's text content. ⚠️ CRITICAL: Content limited to 2000 chars. Cannot change block type or archive blocks. Content exceeding 2000 chars will fail with validation error. For longer content, split across multiple blocks using add_multiple_page_content.

examples: This is the updated line of text.
content.description: The new text content for the block. Replaces existing text content entirely. ⚠️ CRITICAL: Notion API enforces a HARD LIMIT of 2000 characters per text.content field. Content exceeding 2000 chars will cause a validation error. For longer content, split across multiple blocks using append_block_children or add_multiple_page_content.

block_id.description: Identifier of the Notion block to be updated. Must be a valid UUID (with or without dashes). To find a block's ID, other Notion actions that list or retrieve blocks can be used. For updating content within a page (which is also a block), its ID can be obtained using actions like `NOTION_FETCH_DATA` to get page IDs and titles.

language.description: Programming language for code blocks. Required when block_type='code'. Supported values include: 'abap', 'arduino', 'bash', 'basic', 'c', 'clojure', 'coffeescript', 'c++', 'c#', 'css', 'dart', 'diff', 'docker', 'elixir', 'elm', 'erlang', 'flow', 'fortran', 'f#', 'gherkin', 'glsl', 'go', 'graphql', 'groovy', 'haskell', 'html', 'java', 'javascript', 'json', 'julia', 'kotlin', 'latex', 'less', 'lisp', 'livescript', 'lua', 'makefile', 'markdown', 'markup', 'matlab', 'mermaid', 'nix', 'objective-c', 'ocaml', 'pascal', 'perl', 'php', 'plain text', 'powershell', 'prolog', 'protobuf', 'python', 'r', 'reason', 'ruby', 'rust', 'sass', 'scala', 'scheme', 'scss', 'shell', 'sql', 'swift', 'typescript', 'vb.net', 'verilog', 'vhdl', 'visual basic', 'webassembly', 'xml', 'yaml', 'java/c/c++/c#'. If not provided for a code block, the existing language will be preserved.

block_type.description: The type of the block being updated. If not provided, the action will automatically detect the block type by fetching the block first (adds 1 extra API call). If provided, it must match the EXISTING block's type - you cannot change a block's type. Supported types: 'paragraph', 'heading_1', 'heading_2', 'heading_3', 'bulleted_list_item', 'numbered_list_item', 'to_do', 'toggle', 'code', 'quote', 'callout'.

additional_properties.description: Optional dictionary of type-specific properties. Common examples: 'checked' (boolean) for to_do blocks to mark complete/incomplete, 'color' (string like 'blue_background', 'gray', 'red') for text styling, 'is_toggleable' (boolean) for heading blocks to make them collapsible, 'icon' (object with 'type' and 'emoji' fields) for callout blocks. NOTE: Cannot use 'archived' here - use NOTION_DELETE_BLOCK to remove blocks instead. NOTE: Null/None values are automatically filtered out (omitting a property preserves its existing value).

CODA_UPDATE_A_PAGE.description: Update properties for a page. Note that updating a page title or icon requires you to be a Doc Maker in the applicable workspace.

name.description: New name for the page. Note: Updating the page name requires Doc Maker permissions.

docId.description: ID of the doc containing the page to update.

iconName.description: Name of the icon to use for the page. Can be a standard Coda icon name (e.g., 'rocket', 'star') or a custom icon reference. Requires Doc Maker permissions.

imageUrl.description: URL of the cover image to use for the page.

isHidden.description: Whether the page should be hidden. Note: Some pages cannot be hidden (e.g., the sole top-level page in a doc), and this setting will be ignored for those pages.

pageIdOrName.description: ID or name of the page to update. Page IDs are recommended over names as names can be easily changed by users. If using a name, URI-encode it. If multiple pages have the same name, an arbitrary one will be selected.

format.description: The format of the content. Currently only "html" and "markdown" are supported.

content.description: The actual content string in the specified format (HTML or Markdown).

canvasContent.description: The content to insert into the page.

insertionMode.description: How to insert the content. Use "append" to add content to the end of the page.

contentUpdate.description: Content update configuration for appending or inserting content into a page

NOTION_GET_PAGE_MARKDOWN.description: Retrieve a Notion page's full content rendered as Notion-flavored Markdown in a single API call. Use when you need the readable content of a page without recursive block-children fetching.

page_id.description: The UUID of the Notion page to retrieve as markdown. Accepts both hyphenated (8-4-4-4-12) and unhyphenated (32 characters) UUID formats. This endpoint retrieves the full page content rendered as Notion-flavored Markdown in a single API call, avoiding the need for recursive block-children fetching. IMPORTANT: Only page IDs are accepted - database IDs will be rejected. To retrieve database content, use the 'Fetch Database' or 'Query Database' actions instead.

include_transcript.description: Set to true to include meeting note transcripts in the markdown response. Defaults to false if not specified.
